WITH type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name AS media_type_name,
        SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate
    FROM type_rates
)
SELECT
    tr.media_type_name,
    tr.rate,
    tr.track_count,
    tr.rate - mr.mean_rate AS rate_above_mean
FROM type_rates AS tr
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr
WHERE tr.rate > mr.mean_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Media types with no matching tracks are excluded because they have no track-based rate; Bytes values are non-NULL for the totals being computed.
